provenance: Fully synthetic. Names, facts and message are invented for this fixture; no real principal, staff, tenant or WhatsApp/email content is quoted or paraphrased.

source.subject: Sports day meal picks and shirt sizes
source.body:
Good day Principal,

Ahead of Friday's sports day we collected the staff picks. Keisha Mohammed asked for the vegetarian meal and a small shirt. Keisha Ali asked for the chicken meal and an extra-large shirt, and she reminded us she can have no peanuts in her meal. Marcus Persad asked for the fish meal, a medium shirt, and 3 extra jerseys for his relay team. Anil Rampersad is not attending on Friday, so he needs no meal and no shirt.

Please confirm the final counts with the caterer by Wednesday.

Sports Day Committee

cases.note: Every association, negation, quantity and the requested action preserved; aggregate recap in the reply is unattributed and legal.
cases.output:
SUMMARY:
The sports day committee reports staff meal and shirt picks for Friday. Keisha Mohammed wants the vegetarian meal and a small shirt; Keisha Ali wants the chicken meal and an extra-large shirt with no peanuts in her meal. Marcus Persad wants the fish meal, a medium shirt and 3 extra jerseys for his relay team. Anil Rampersad is not attending, so he needs no meal or shirt. They ask you to confirm the final counts with the caterer by Wednesday.

REPLY:
Thank you for collecting the picks. I will confirm the final counts with the caterer by Wednesday, covering the vegetarian, chicken and fish meals, the small, medium and extra-large shirts, and the 3 extra jerseys, and I have the note that Keisha Ali's meal must contain no peanuts. Noted that Anil Rampersad is not attending.
